propositions: Three near-identical walkers that discover a ticket's replacement link (_has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, find_replacement) must be consolidated into a single shared implementation

The shared replacement link walk (_duplicates_ outbound then _supersedes_ inbound) must be guarded to appear only in close_disposition.py, with construct-uniqueness verified by a test matching the conjunction of find_inbound_relationships and 'supersedes'
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must be derived from DISPOSITION_CLASSES (not restated) so the two cannot drift, verified by identity assertion not mere equality

The three walkers differ in liveness checks, class guards, and failure handling (_recorded_replacement_target continues to inbound after subject reduce failure while the other two stop early), requiring these behaviors to be preserved in wrappers rather than merged into core
All four existing pinning test suites must pass unchanged with zero assertion edits and the monkeypatch seams must retain their exact names and signatures for test compatibility
